privacy.title: Applicant privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains how {company} processes the data you share when applying.
privacy.controller: {company} is the controller of your application data.
privacy.data: Your first and last name, email, phone, profile link, CV, message and answers to the form questions, as well as the notes and evaluations of the hiring team.
privacy.purpose: Reviewing your application, contacting you about this position and, where relevant, other positions matching your profile.
privacy.retention: Your data is kept for {months} months after your last exchange with the company, then automatically anonymised.
privacy.rights: You can ask to access, correct, export or delete your data.
privacy.contact: Write to <link>{email}</link> to exercise these rights.
privacy.contactFallback: Contact the company through its website to exercise these rights.
